scope: Giza radar scenes, historical acquisition records, ground surveys and external controls used in the evidence review. Each record labels the meaning of its date. One pass can have several products. Archive counts reflect the dated searches.

items.title: Sentinel-1 archive over the three pyramids
items.access: Free catalogue; Earthdata Login for images
items.description: The dated search returned 820 scene records. Each footprint covered all three pyramids. The chamber test used other acquisitions.
items.rights: Copernicus Sentinel data are free and open. ASF requires Earthdata Login for product downloads.

items.title: Petrie chamber and passage survey
items.description: Petrie surveyed Giza in 1880-82 and published the measurements in 1883. Chamber and passage dimensions anchor the known locations.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: North Face Corridor muography
items.description: An independently surveyed corridor checks position and shape. The article reports detector results and derived geometry.
items.rights: Published article under CC BY 4.0. Credit the authors. Check figure credits for third-party material.

items.title: Big Void muography
items.product: Muon observations from three detector technologies
items.description: Independent evidence places a large void above the Grand Gallery. Its precise shape and orientation remain unresolved.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Western Cemetery ground survey
items.description: The joint survey measured shallow anomalies west of Khufu from 2021 to 2023. The 2024 paper includes ground radar and resistivity profiles.
items.rights: Published article under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Credit the authors.

items.title: Osiris Shaft excavation
items.description: Published excavation levels and plans provide a reference for the shaft model.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: North Face Corridor ground survey
items.description: Three physical methods tested the corridor geometry. The study provides independent comparisons with muography.
items.rights: Published article under CC BY 4.0. Credit the authors. Check figure credits for third-party material.

items.title: Khufu summit GPS survey
items.description: Surveyed modern summit mast anchors exterior registration. The original base center has a separate uncertainty.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: EGM96 height reference
items.description: The geoid grid converts survey heights into satellite ellipsoid heights. The original local leveling datum remains uncertain.
items.rights: US NGA source grid, public domain. PROJ distributes the GeoTIFF.

items.title: Khufu X33 published reconstruction
items.description: An interactive mesh and display textures show the registered reconstruction. The source does not distribute a phase-preserving scene.
items.rights: Public display. An open licence for the underlying radar was not established.

items.title: Western Cemetery fitted scores
items.description: Eight profiles contain fitted scores at 999 depth labels. These data can test rendering and normalization.
items.rights: Public display. An open licence for the underlying radar was not established.

items.title: Osiris Shaft reconstruction
items.description: The released interactive model permits comparison with excavation plans.
items.rights: Public display. An open licence for the underlying radar was not established.

items.title: Khafre east and west sections
items.description: The published images cover the upper 50 m. They do not span the 648 m claim.
items.rights: Public display. An open licence for the underlying radar was not established.

items.title: Original Khafre radar scenes
items.platform: Capella and Umbra named in press abstract
items.description: The conference material gives no verified scene IDs or acquisition times for the 648 m claim.
items.rights: No verified public data release.

items.title: Original numerical shaft volume
items.description: The published figures do not provide voxel values, a datum or a reproducible depth transform.
items.rights: No verified public data release.

items.title: Certified buried and empty targets
items.description: An external ground survey would need to identify buried targets and certify comparable empty sites.
items.rights: No verified public data release.

items.title: Claimed ICEYE-X13 input
items.description: The original X13 product ID, acquisition time and release terms remain unresolved. The public X50 scene is separate.
items.rights: No verified public data release.

items.title: Claimed ICEYE-X33 input
items.description: The author published a reconstruction. No matching provider scene or open licence for the phase data was verified.
items.rights: No verified public data release.

items.title: Instrumented surface-motion reference
items.product: Published LVDT displacement and velocity curves
items.access: Public paper; original instrument traces unverified
items.description: Ground observations come from a driven surface-mounted reflector. Waveforms were digitized from plots for nine trials.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: El Osario satellite scene
items.product: Dwell Fine VV, complex SLC GeoTIFF
items.description: The split-aperture estimate missed the held-out survey axis.
items.rights: CC BY 4.0. Credit ICEYE.

items.title: Feathered Serpent Temple satellite scene
items.description: The three-band intensity test missed the held-out tunnel axis by 88 degrees. Static brightness missed by 89 degrees.
items.rights: CC BY 4.0. Credit Umbra.

items.title: El Osario cave and shaft point cloud
items.description: The registered cave cloud provided a held-out axis and footprint. Dates cover the entire archive. The cave layer has no separately dated acquisition here.
items.rights: CC BY-NC. Credit the contributors named on OpenHeritage3D.

items.title: Feathered Serpent tunnel survey
items.product: Excavation laser scan and GPR profiles
items.description: Two independent publications constrain the reference angle to 107 degrees with about 5 degrees of reading uncertainty.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Egypt gravity stations
items.description: The closest station was 5.83 km from Khafre. The table omits individual occupation dates and uncertainty.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: BGI gravity station catalogue
items.description: Two public locations lie in the 6 km search box. The map omits measured gravity, altitude and uncertainty.
items.rights: Public station locations. BGI terms apply separately to access and reuse of measurements.

items.title: SRI 1 absolute gravity station
items.description: One absolute station lies about 5.64 km from Khafre. It does not sample individual shafts.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Unified terrestrial gravity database
items.description: The authors report 9,724 observations. Near-Khafre spacing and uncertainty are unknown.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Operation Kheops microgravity
items.product: Profiles in Khufu and a boat pit
items.description: The study reports 46 Queen’s passage stations and 35 boat-pit readings. It provides a local sensitivity benchmark.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Khafre chamber acoustic soundings
items.product: Published sounding plots and station plan
items.description: The team measured downward from 11 chamber and passage locations. Published echoes span tens of metres.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Giza plateau ground radar lines
items.description: Two 210 m lines ran near the pyramid base. The study reports no deep phase-calibrated survey below the footprint.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Giza groundwater survey
items.platform: Ground radar, seismic and resistivity teams
items.product: Published site map and geophysical profiles
items.description: The paper maps 10 electrical, 26 seismic and 19 radar profiles. These constrain shallow geology and aquifers.
items.rights: Published article under CC BY 4.0. Credit the authors. Check figure credits for third-party material.

items.title: Khafre chamber muography
items.description: Detectors inside the Belzoni chamber measured rock above them starting in 1967. The team published in 1970. Their geometry excludes the proposed deep shafts.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Khafre backing-block material tests
items.description: Three Khafre samples have reported densities from 2.25 to 2.31 g/cm³. No deep borehole density profile was available.
items.rights: Published article under CC BY 4.0. Credit the authors. Check figure credits for third-party material.

items.title: Trans-African gravity traverse
items.description: The primary abstract reports 608 readings. It does not supply a local station series across Khafre.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: ScIDEP Khafre muography
items.description: This detector study specifies the planned viewing geometry. It does not release a measured deep-shaft volume.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.

items.title: Canini two-date chamber comparison
items.description: The author links the protocol and diagnostic outputs for two public Capella scenes.
items.rights: Public display. An open licence for the underlying radar was not established.

items.title: Canini v1.9 chamber comparison
items.description: The reported comparison used Capella and ICEYE-X50 data. The published scores are downstream products.
items.rights: Public display. An open licence for the underlying radar was not established.

items.title: Capella archaeological archive search
items.description: The overlap search checked 9,999 product footprints at ten named landmarks. Khufu had twelve products from two acquisitions. The link opens the complex-image collection.
items.rights: CC BY 4.0. Credit Capella Space.

items.title: Umbra archaeological archive search
items.description: The search checked 24,542 metadata records. Three records at Teotihuacan represent a single acquisition.
items.rights: CC BY 4.0. Credit Umbra.

items.title: ICEYE archaeological archive search
items.description: The search checked 740 records. One acquisition covers both El Osario and El Castillo. A separate scene covers Khufu.
items.rights: CC BY 4.0. Credit ICEYE.

items.title: Nagoya Khafre muon exposure
items.date_kind: Conference month; individual exposure dates unspecified
items.product: Reported detector exposure and track count
items.access: Open presentation; raw tracks not released here
items.description: The team reports about 300 days and 70 million tracks at the chamber location used by Alvarez. Analysis was ongoing at the conference.
items.rights: Free source link. Consult the rights statement for reuse of figures or data.
